    Profile

    Longinus is the Dark Killer who represents envy, and was guided to this world from the continent of Ragna. Cautious and methodical, she is fully aware of the extent of her own capabilities, allowing her to calmly set her eyes on the task at hand and fearlessly take down an opponent with a single strike.

    Origin: Ragna
    Gender: Female
    Height: 148cm
    Weight: 40kg
    Birthday: Apr 13
    Blood Type: Type AB
    Zodiac: Aries
    Likes: Tomato juice
    Hobbies: —
    Illust: 渡り棒
    CV: 花澤香菜
